title: Rental e-scooters: keep or remove?
titleFr: Trottinettes en libre-service : pour ou contre ?
summary: Keep Paris's rental e-scooters? A real votation (2 Apr 2023) with very low turnout: we test whether the simulated likely voters differ from everyone, and compare with the official result by sector.
proposalFr: La Ville de Paris organise une votation citoyenne le 2 avril 2023. Question : « Pour ou contre les trottinettes en libre-service à Paris ? » Environ 15 000 trottinettes électriques en libre-service, proposées par trois opérateurs, circulent à Paris dans le cadre de contrats qui se terminent fin août 2023. Voter « Pour » : la Ville renouvelle les contrats et les trottinettes en libre-service restent. Voter « Contre » : elles disparaissent de Paris à la fin des contrats. Les trottinettes personnelles, les vélos et les scooters en libre-service ne sont pas concernés. (Une position favorable (+) signifie voter « Pour » : garder les trottinettes en libre-service.)
proposalEn: Paris citizens' vote, 2 Apr 2023: 'For or against self-service (rental) e-scooters?' About 15,000 rental e-scooters from three operators run under contracts ending in August 2023. 'For' = the city renews the contracts and they stay; 'Against' = they disappear from Paris. Personal scooters and shared bikes are not affected.

baselines.name: Uniform poll (Ifop-Fiducial for Le Figaro and Sud Radio)
baselines.description: The pre-vote poll figure applied to every sector.

baselines.name: Demographic rule (no LLM): young-voter share
baselines.description: yes = 0.05 + 0.45 × share of voters aged 18–29 — i.e. under-30s split 50/50, older voters 5% 'Pour'. Coefficients fixed before any comparison.

baselines.name: Same simulation, no turnout model (everyone in Paris)
baselines.description: All simulated Paris residents counted equally, ignoring who would actually vote.

leakage.notes: Leakage probe pending API key (run pipeline/leakage_probe.py). Model-card pretraining cutoffs: Nemotron 3 Nano 2025-06-25, Nemotron 3 Super 2025-06, Nemotron 3 Ultra 2025-09; vote date 2023-04-02. All three Nemotron 3 models were pre-trained on data up to at least June 2025, after this vote: treat the backtest as possibly contaminated and run the leakage probe.

poll.org: Ifop-Fiducial for Le Figaro and Sud Radio
poll.note: Representative sample of Parisians aged 18+ (quotas after stratification by arrondissement, online). Voting intention among Paris voters, % of expressed: Pour 30 / Contre 70. Same question as the ballot.

uncertainty.method: K=3 proposal paraphrases × 2 models (NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B, nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b) on a random 300-resident subsample; yesRange = full-sample yes share shifted by the min/max deviation of the runs from the main run on that subsample (MOCK: seeded noise, not real model variation)

notes: MOCK RUN: no language model was called (no API key). Stances and texts come from simple deterministic heuristics and templates marked [demo]/[démo].
Every text is a simulated voice generated for a synthetic resident, never a real person. Results are hypotheses to test, not evidence of public opinion.

Participation: logit(p) = logit(participationBase or participationPropensity) + 0.35·exposure + 0.5·(LLM self-report − 0.5) + c, with c = -3.771 calibrated so expected participants = 7.46% of the 1082 residents in scope. The LLM self-report is only a weak rank modifier. The highlighted attendees on the map are one seeded random draw; all attendee numbers use the probability weights.

Neighbour talk: 280 random pairs (217 within 300 m, the rest in the same district); 65 of 560 residents changed stance. Arguments that travelled most: Other options exist (metro, bikes) (91); Clutter on pavements (89); Indifferent — rarely sees them (34).
Does talking help? Sector MAE 0.062 before talk vs 0.054 after (more accurate).

Backtest rules: participation coefficients, turnout target (= official turnout) and the demographic baseline were fixed before comparing with sector results; nothing is tuned on the vote being predicted.
Imputed attributes (car, heavy car, tenure, nationality, workplace) come from INSEE statistics, not from the NVIDIA dataset, and are labelled as imputed.
